t: Flavor of Love: When Flavorettes Attack
d: Flav bring his five remaining girls to "Big Boy's Neighborhood" on LA's biggest Hip Hop Radio Station to have live callers help him decide which girl is right for him.

t: Flavor of Love: Its A Family Flav Fair
d: With only four women left vying for Flav's affection the moment of truth has arrived, meeting the parents.
After the last elimination, Flav tells his final three girls to pack their bags because they are heading to Cannes, France!
Episode 14 is a clip show with never before seen footage.

t: Flavor of Love: Parlez Vous Flavor
d: After a season of ups and downs and a dramatic twist of plans in Cannes, it's down to Flav's final girls.

t: Flavor of Love: Reunion After The Lovin
d: On the reunion episode, Flav and 20 girls talk about what happened on the show and what is going on in the lives right now.

t: Rock of Love: Back to the Rocking Horse
d: Twenty more beautiful babes vie for his love and affection. Some bare more than their souls in an attempt to grab Bret's attention.
In the first ever Peep Show Contest, the girls all compete for a date with Bret by showing off their greatest talents.
But things turn ugly when the most hated girl in the house gets alone time with Bret  the fangs come out and the girls are out for blood!

t: Rock of Love: A Ride on the Wild Side
st: A Ride on the Wild Side
d: Bret wants a girl with good manual skills so he tests their aptitude with nuts and bolts in a custom motorcycle build off.

t: Rock of Love: Mud Bowl II
d: The Divine Nine compete in the second annual Bret Michaels Mud Bowl!

t: Rock of Love: Once a Cowgirl
d: For the two women who have yet to win a date with Bret, Rodeo's Rocking Rodeo could be their last chance to make a connection.

t: Rock of Love: Red, White and a Little Blue
st: Red, White and a Little Blue
d: The remaining seven girls display their ability to rock an audience as they perform at a USO show for military veterans.
With only six girls left in the house, tensions run high as Bret tests the girls' creativity by making them shoot, direct and edit their own music videos.

t: Rock of Love: Going to Ex-tremes
d: Bret shocks the girls by inviting their exes. He takes the guys out on the town to dig up dirt on the girls.
Bret surprises the final four with a trip to Las Vegas. One girl's lies cause Bret to question her intentions toward him.
Bret wants to know more about the three remaining girls, and what better way to get the 411 than moving their parents into the house!
